      "snippet": "You pasted a path as if it were a command.
In Termux (bash), when you enter:
swiftCopy code/data/data/com.termux/files/home/metablooms-ltm

the shell tries to run it, so you get:
markdownCopy code[FAIL]: command not found

Do this instead:
bashCopy codecd /data/data/com.termux/files/home/metablooms-ltm
pwd
ls -la

Or (same thing, shorter):
bashCopy codecd ~/metablooms-ltm
pwd
ls -la

Quick verification that it’s a real git repo:
bashCopy codecd ~/metablooms-ltm
test -d .git && echo "[OK] git rep"
